an3.155:1.1: pubbaṇhasamayaṁ → pubbanhasamayaṁ (bj) | supubbaṇho → supubbanho (bj) | bhikkhave → ye bhikkhave (bj: machasaṁ)
an3.155:2.1: ye → ye hi (bj) | majjhanhikasamayaṁ → majjhantikaṁ samayaṁ (bj); majjhantikasamayaṁ (sya-all) | sumajjhanhiko → sumajjhantiko (bj, sya-all) | samayaṁ → majjhantimaṁ samayaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
an3.155:3.1: ye → ye hi (bj) | sāyanhasamayaṁ → sāyaṇhasamayaṁ (sya-all) | susāyanho → susāyaṇho (sya-all)
an3.155:4.2: suppabhātaṁ → supabhātaṁ (sya-all) | suvuṭṭhitaṁ → sukhuṭṭhitaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | suhuṭṭhitaṁ → suvuṭṭhitaṁ (cck: sī. pī.)
an3.155:5.4: paṇīdhi → paṇidhi (sya-all) | paṇidhiyo → paṇidhī tā (bj: machasaṁ) | padakkhiṇe → paṇidhiyo padakkhiṇā (cck: sī. pī.); paṇidhi te padakkhiṇā (cck: syā. kaṁ.)
an3.155:5.6: labhatatthe → labhantatthe (bj: machasaṁ) | labhantatthe → labhatatthe (cck: sī. pī.)
an3.155:6.6:
pañcamo → tassuddānaṁ :- 
akusalañca sāvajjaṁ visamā sukhitā saha 
caturo khatā vandanā pubbaṇho nāma te dasāni. – machasaṁ (bj note)
